The term '''Republic Protector''' was one used to describe those military [[Officer/Legends|officers]] or [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who were charged with the protection of a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] or high ranking government official within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
